privacy.ai_training_note: Privacy policy explicitly states: 'We do not use personal data for the purpose of using automated decision making or profiling.' Ably acts as a data processor; customer content/data is held momentarily (2 minutes to 24 hours) for delivery purposes only.
privacy.data_region: Multi-region: EU, US, Australia. Organizations can control where data streams route and store messages exclusively in specified regions.

security.name: Encryption in Transit
security.value: TLS 1.2+ for all client-to-server and server-to-server communication (default/mandatory)

security.name: Encryption at Rest
security.value: AES-256 encryption available using private keys, preventing even Ably from reading messages without authorization

security.name: DDoS Mitigation
security.value: Network edge detection blocks invalid connections; Cloudflare integration; massive scalability absorbs traffic spikes

security.name: Authentication
security.value: Token-based authentication with JWT support, API keys, key expiration limits, granular channel and action permissions

security.name: Audit Logging
security.value: Comprehensive audit logging of access and operations

security.name: Data Access Controls
security.value: Role-based access control, API key scoping, channel-level permissions

security.name: Infrastructure Security
security.value: AWS-hosted with multiple regions, firewalls, IDS/IPS systems, DNSSEC, endpoint detection & response

security.name: Backup & Disaster Recovery
security.value: Data backups and erasure capabilities. Recovery Time Objective: 12 hours. Recovery Point Objective: 24 hours. 99.999% uptime SLA.

security.name: Vulnerability Management
security.value: Regular penetration testing, responsible disclosure program, code analysis, vulnerability assessments

security.name: Data Residency
security.value: EU, US, Australia options. International transfers use Standard Contractual Clauses (EU and UK GDPR compliant)

products.name: Ably Pub/Sub
products.data_scope: Message payloads and metadata; data retained momentarily (2-24 hours)
products.notes: Core product for pub/sub messaging. AES-256 encryption support, global distribution, per-minute billing model

products.name: Ably Chat
products.data_scope: Chat messages, user presence, message history
products.notes: Purpose-built chat APIs optimized for high-scale user loads. Available as part of enterprise offerings

products.name: Ably AI Transport
products.data_scope: AI agent sessions, agentic interactions, state synchronization
products.notes: New product (2024+) for building resilient, multi-device AI experiences. Drop-in infrastructure for stateful AI sessions

products.name: Ably LiveObjects
products.data_scope: Application state objects across users and devices
products.notes: Real-time sync for application state at any scale. Supports multi-user collaboration

products.name: Ably Spaces
products.data_scope: Collaborative workspace state, user presence, permissions
products.notes: Purpose-built APIs for collaborative environments. Includes presence, locks, and permissions management

products.name: Ably LiveSync
products.data_scope: Database change events, frontend client updates
products.notes: Seamlessly sync database changes with frontend, publishing changes to millions of clients reliably

compare.pricing_model: Usage-based: per-minute billing or MAU (monthly active users). Volume discounts as consumption increases. Enterprise customers available.
compare.data_residency: Yes - customers can control routing to EU, US, or Australia regions
